for ob in targets:

def lin(rgb):
 rgb=np.asarray(rgb,dtype=np.float32)
 return np.where(rgb<=.04045,rgb/12.92,((rgb+.055)/1.055)**2.4)
def srgb(rgb):
 return np.where(rgb<=.0031308,rgb*12.92,1.055*np.maximum(rgb,0)**(1/2.4)-.055)
def save_img(name,arr,color=False):
 arr=arr.astype(np.float32).copy()
 if color:arr[:,:,:3]=lin(np.clip(arr[:,:,:3],0,1))
 h,w=arr.shape[:2]
 im=bpy.data.images.new(name+'_author',width=w,height=h,alpha=True)
 im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if color else 'Non-Color'
 im.pixels.foreach_set(arr.ravel());im.filepath_raw=str(tex/(name+'.png'));im.file_format='PNG';im.save()
 fresh=bpy.data.images.load(str(tex/(name+'.png')),check_existing=False)
 fresh.name=name;fresh.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if color else 'Non-Color';fresh.pack()
 bpy.data.images.remove(im)
 return fresh
def pixels(im,color=False):
 w,h=im.size;a=np.empty(w*h*4,np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(a);a=a.reshape(h,w,4)
 if color:a[:,:,:3]=srgb(a[:,:,:3])
 return a
def smooth(a,b,x):
 t=np.clip((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)
def noise(u,v,nx,ny,seed):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);g=rng.random((ny+1,nx+1)).astype(np.float32)
 X=u*nx;Y=v*ny;ix=np.minimum(X.astype(int),nx-1);iy=np.minimum(Y.astype(int),ny-1)
 fx=X-ix;fy=Y-iy;fx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx);fy=fy*fy*(3-2*fy)
 return (g[iy,ix]*(1-fx)+g[iy,ix+1]*fx)*(1-fy)+(g[iy+1,ix]*(1-fx)+g[iy+1,ix+1]*fx)*fy
def surface(mat,col,height,rough,metal,dx,dy,strength=.55):
 nt=mat.node_tree;p=next(n for n in nt.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
 for n in list(nt.nodes):
  if n!=p and n.type!='OUTPUT_MATERIAL':nt.nodes.remove(n)
 p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(1,1,1,1);p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=1;p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=1
 gy,gx=np.gradient(height,dy,dx)
 nv=np.stack([-gx,-gy,np.ones_like(gx)],-1);nv/=np.linalg.norm(nv,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
 normal=np.ones_like(col);normal[:,:,:3]=nv*.5+.5
 orm=np.ones_like(col);orm[:,:,1]=rough;orm[:,:,2]=metal
 for suffix,arr in [('albedo',col),('normal',normal),('orm',orm)]:
  t=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');t.image=save_img(mat.name+'_'+suffix,arr,suffix=='albedo')
  if suffix=='albedo':nt.links.new(t.outputs['Color'],p.inputs['Base Color'])
  elif suffix=='normal':
   n=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeNormalMap');n.inputs['Strength'].default_value=strength
   nt.links.new(t.outputs['Color'],n.inputs['Color']);nt.links.new(n.outputs['Normal'],p.inputs['Normal'])
  else:
   s=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor');s.mode='RGB';nt.links.new(t.outputs['Color'],s.inputs['Color'])
   nt.links.new(s.outputs['Green'],p.inputs['Roughness']);nt.links.new(s.outputs['Blue'],p.inputs['Metallic'])

 hidden=(exp.hide_viewport,exp.hide_render);exp.hide_viewport=False;exp.hide_render=False

 for ob in exp.objects:ob.hide_set(False);ob.select_set(True)
 bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=next(iter(exp.objects))
 (cap/'export_progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'stage':label,'status':'exporting'}),encoding='utf8')
 bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(root/'assets/coast/shipyard_combined.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,export_apply=True,export_yup=True,export_cameras=False,export_lights=False)
 exp.hide_viewport,exp.hide_render=hidden
 bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
 (cap/'export_progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'stage':label,'status':'complete'}),encoding='utf8')
# Sixteen existing UV regions, same physical sheet proportions.
TW,TH=512,1024
v,u=np.mgrid[0:TH,0:TW].astype(np.float32)/np.array([TH-1,TW-1],np.float32)[:,None,None]
col=np.ones((TH*4,TW*4,4),np.float32);height=np.zeros(col.shape[:2],np.float32)
rough=np.zeros_like(height);metal=np.zeros_like(height);stats=[]
for k in range(16):
 wall=k>=8;seed=61901+k*73
 wash=noise(u,v,4,7,seed);edgegrain=noise(u,v,9,18,seed+1);brush=noise(u,v,28,11,seed+2)
 # Scalloped but quiet corrosion bands follow seams and wet lower ends.
 left=(.034+.046*wash+.022*edgegrain)-u
 right=(.012+.026*wash)-(1-u)
 bottom=(.055+.07*wash+.024*edgegrain)-v
 boundary=np.maximum(np.maximum(left,right),bottom)
 # Sparse elongated, deliberately placed paint losses, not a field of fine speckles.
 centers=[(.10+.07*(k%3),.28+.12*(k%4),.15,.17)]
 if not wall:centers+=[(.79,.60-.07*(k%3),.17,.23)]
 for cx,cy,rx,ry in centers:
  dist=1-((u-cx)/rx)**2-((v-cy)/ry)**2+.40*(edgegrain-.5)+.18*(brush-.5)
  boundary=np.maximum(boundary,dist*.12)
 rust=smooth(-.009,.009,boundary)
 # Restrained chipped paint fringe; no bright halo around each patch.
 fringe=smooth(-.022,-.005,boundary)*(1-rust)
 base=np.array([.51,.606,.621] if wall else [.43,.527,.554])+[-.013,.002,.014,-.004][k%4]
 rgb=np.broadcast_to(base,(TH,TW,3)).copy()
 # Broad pigment washes with small value steps, interrupted brush detail.
 steps=smooth(.28,.39,wash)*.016+smooth(.60,.72,wash)*.014-.015
 rgb+=steps[:,:,None]+(brush[:,:,None]-.5)*.009
 rgb+=fringe[:,:,None]*np.array([.023,.009,-.002])
 rustcolor=np.array([.592,.382,.267])+(wash[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.060,.045,.030])
 rgb=rgb*(1-rust[:,:,None])+rustcolor*rust[:,:,None]
 # Short oxide runoff under actual fastening columns, only where paint is lost.
 for cx in [.085,.915]:
  tail=np.exp(-((u-cx)/.009)**2)*np.exp(-((v-.84)/.065)**2)
  rgb-=tail[:,:,None]*np.array([.026,.025,.019])
 yy=(k//4)*TH;xx=(k%4)*TW;s=np.s_[yy:yy+TH,xx:xx+TW]
 col[s][:,:,:3]=np.clip(rgb,0,1)
 height[s]=(brush-.5)*.000045-rust*(edgegrain-.5)*.00009
 rough[s]=(.76 if wall else .68)+wash*.045+rust*.10
 metal[s]=(.055 if wall else .32)*(1-rust)+.01*rust
 stats.append({'tile':k,'role':'wall' if wall else 'roof','rust_fraction':float(np.mean(rust>.5))})
surface(matmap['Shipyard_RivetedSheetSteel'],col,height,rough,metal,.96/TW,4.0/TH,.55)
# Iron frame reads as cool charcoal rather than a black grid.
S=512;v,u=np.mgrid[0:S,0:S].astype(np.float32)/(S-1);n=noise(u,v,5,7,701);b=noise(u,v,23,17,702)
c=np.ones((S,S,4),np.float32);r=smooth(.70,.81,n)
c[:,:,:3]=np.array([.313,.369,.374])+(n[:,:,None]-.5)*.035
c[:,:,:3]=c[:,:,:3]*(1-r[:,:,None])+np.array([.46,.326,.246])*r[:,:,None]
surface(matmap['Shipyard_HeavyOxideIron'],c,(b-.5)*.00006,.67+n*.10,.45*(1-r)+.015*r,1/S,1/S,.4)
# Painted joinery retains directional wear without the old photographic mottling.
m=matmap['Shipyard_BlueSaltPaint'];p=next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
 if n.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and n.image and any(l.to_socket==p.inputs['Base Color'] for l in n.outputs['Color'].links):
  a=pixels(n.image,True);rgb=a[:,:,:3];mean=rgb.mean(axis=(0,1))
  a[:,:,:3]=np.clip(np.array([.47,.565,.576])+(rgb-mean)*.28,0,1)
  n.image=save_img(m.name+'_albedo',a,True)
 if n.type=='NORMAL_MAP':n.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.32
set_solid('Shipyard_DustyWorkshopGlass',[.34,.435,.44],.40,.08)
(cap/'material_plan.json').write_text(json.dumps({'palette':'blue-grey sheet, restrained ochre oxide, warm limestone, honey timber','sheet_regions':stats,'material_copies':{k:m.name for k,m in matmap.items()},'shared_mesh_copies':list(copied),'geometry_changed':False},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
